title: STMTopRC: A MATLAB package for ground-structure topology optimization of reinforced-concrete strut-and-tie models
description: STMTopRC is an open-source, case-based, and regression-tested MATLAB implementation of the established multi-material and grouped-volume ground-structure framework for conceptual strut-and-tie model generation. The package separates problem definition from the core solver and supports tie-region and tie-angle controls, load-path evaluation, automated reporting, and one-command reproduction of the examples. Published benchmarks and component-level tests verify the optimizer, state solver, analytical sensitivities, symmetry treatment, and load-path calculation. Its explicit equation-to-code mapping, executable examples, and self-tests support reproducible research, methodological extension, and code-based instruction.
